e2e_test_strategy.name: APEX-OS End-to-End Testing Strategy
e2e_test_strategy.scope: Full system integration across ApexAMM, ApexGraphSwarm, Data Center Commander, and Apex FIET

test_environment.description: Isolated test environment mirroring production topology

data_setup.market_data: Synthetic order book data for 200+ instruments across 12 venues
data_setup.historical_returns: 2 years of 1-minute bars for FHS VaR calibration
data_setup.settlement_accounts: Pre-funded escrow accounts on permissioned blockchain

test_components.name: Full Trading Lifecycle — Signal to Settlement
test_components.description: Validate complete trading workflow from alpha signal generation through cross-venue PvP settlement

test_scenarios.name: Happy Path — Single Venue
steps: Ingest alpha signal from GraphRAG (top-k subgraph retrieval + GAT forward pass)
Run TCN+Transformer prediction inference (sub-100ms)
Solve MILP optimization for quote placement (sub-200ms)
Execute pre-trade risk check (FHS VaR/CVaR, sub-50ms)
Route order via Kafka to target venue
Receive fill confirmation via WebSocket
Trigger PvP settlement with 2-second finality
Verify audit trail completeness
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Full lifecycle completes in <3 seconds with all invariants satisfied
assertions: Prediction MDN produces valid 3-component Gaussian mixture
MILP optimality gap < 5% or greedy fallback engaged
Audit trail contains all 7 stages with valid trace_id

test_scenarios.name: Multi-Venue Arbitrage Execution
steps: Detect cross-venue price discrepancy via latency arbitrage detector
Generate alpha signal for arbitrage opportunity
Run prediction on both venues simultaneously
Solve MILP for simultaneous buy/sell across venues
Execute risk check for combined exposure
Route orders to both venues via Kafka
Handle partial fill on one venue
Trigger PvP settlement with netting
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Arbitrage executed with net exposure within limits, settlement netted correctly

test_scenarios.name: High-Frequency Signal Decay
steps: Ingest 1000+ signals/second from 40+ sources
Apply signal decay model with time-weighted reliability
Verify GraphRAG retrieval latency <10ms
Validate Platt scaling calibration on rolling 30-day window
Confirm stale graph fallback to inverse-variance weighting
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Signal aggregation maintains <10ms latency under 10x load spike

kill_chain.description: Verify system safely halts when any critical stage fails

test_components.name: Risk Kill Chain — Breach Detection to Recovery
test_components.description: Validate risk limit enforcement, kill switch activation, and graceful recovery

test_scenarios.name: CVaR Breach → Kill Switch → Recovery
steps: Build portfolio approaching CVaR limit (95% of threshold)
Execute trades that push CVaR beyond limit
Verify kill switch triggers within 100ms
Confirm all venue connectors receive cancel-all command
Verify position limit enforcer blocks new orders
Wait for risk metrics to decay below threshold
Verify kill switch disarm and trading resumes
Validate audit trail captures full breach→recovery cycle
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Kill switch triggers in <100ms, all orders cancelled, recovery automatic

test_scenarios.name: Cross-Venue Correlation Breakdown
steps: Inject stress scenario (2008 crisis parameters)
Verify DCC-GARCH correlation update within 5 minutes
Confirm correlation stress to 95th percentile historical values
Validate VaR recalculation with stressed correlations
Verify position limits adjusted downward
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Risk metrics reflect stressed correlations within 5 minutes

test_scenarios.name: Cascading Failure — Risk Engine → Orchestration
steps: Kill risk engine process
Verify failure detector identifies missing heartbeats within 300ms
Confirm swarm coordinator reassigns risk tasks to backup agent
Validate circuit breaker opens for risk service
Verify fallback to conservative risk limits
Restart risk engine and verify state synchronization
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: System degrades gracefully, no trading on stale risk data

test_components.name: Swarm Orchestration — Agent Failure and Recovery
test_components.description: Validate hierarchical swarm coordination with Byzantine fault tolerance

test_scenarios.name: Tier 3 Agent Failure and Replacement
steps: Register 200+ agents across 12 venues
Kill 5 random Tier 3 execution agents
Verify heartbeat detection within 300ms (3 missed heartbeats)
Confirm task reassignment to healthy agents
Validate no in-flight task loss
Verify replacement agents receive full state context
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Agent failure detected in <300ms, tasks reassigned, zero data loss

test_scenarios.name: Tier 1 Byzantine Fault Tolerance
steps: Deploy 4 Tier 1 global orchestrator nodes
Inject Byzantine behavior in 1 node (conflicting state proposals)
Verify PBFT consensus reaches agreement with f=1 tolerance
Confirm view-change protocol excludes Byzantine node
Validate global state consistency across remaining 3 nodes
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: PBFT tolerates 1 Byzantine fault, consensus maintained

test_scenarios.name: Cross-Region Consensus Latency
steps: Measure Tier 1 PBFT consensus latency across 3 regions
Verify consensus completes within 500ms budget
Inject network partition between regions
Verify partition-tolerant consensus (CAP theorem validation)
Confirm state reconciliation after partition heals
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Consensus within 500ms, partition-tolerant, consistent after heal

test_components.name: Event-Driven Integration — Kafka Backbone
test_components.description: Validate event-driven architecture with exactly-once semantics for critical flows

test_scenarios.name: Trade Execution Exactly-Once Semantics
steps: Produce TradeExecuted event with idempotent producer
Simulate consumer failure after processing but before offset commit
Verify redelivery does not cause duplicate settlement
Confirm idempotent consumer deduplicates via trade_id
Validate DLQ routing after 3 retries
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Exactly-once processing for trade execution, no duplicate settlements

test_scenarios.name: Cross-Region MirrorMaker 2 Replication
steps: Produce events to US-East Kafka cluster
Verify replication to EU-Central and APAC-Singapore
Measure replication lag under 1M events/second
Inject primary region failure
Verify consumer failover to secondary region
Confirm zero event loss with transactional producers
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Cross-region replication with <1s lag, zero loss on failover

test_scenarios.name: Backpressure and Consumer Lag
steps: Generate 10x load spike (10M events/second)
Verify consumer lag monitoring triggers HPA scaling
Confirm non-critical consumers paused when lag persists
Validate rate limiter protects downstream services
Verify circuit breaker opens for overloaded services
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: System scales horizontally, protects critical paths, degrades gracefully

test_scenarios.name: Service-to-Service mTLS with Certificate Rotation
steps: Verify all services have SPIFFE identities via SVID
Confirm mTLS handshake on all service-to-service calls
Trigger 24-hour certificate rotation
Verify overlapping certificates prevent connection failures
Validate OPA authorization policies enforce least privilege
Confirm all auth events logged to immutable audit trail
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Zero-trust enforced, certificate rotation seamless, full audit trail

test_scenarios.name: Insider Threat Detection
steps: Simulate compromised service attempting unauthorized access
Verify OPA denies access based on contextual policy
Confirm audit trail captures attempted breach
Validate Falco runtime threat detection alerts
Verify automatic credential revocation via Vault
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Unauthorized access denied, detected, and audited

test_components.name: Graph Kernel to Swarm Coordination
test_components.description: Validate ApexGraphSwarm graph algorithms driving swarm task allocation

test_scenarios.name: Task Allocation via Bipartite Matching
steps: Generate agent-task compatibility graph
Run bipartite matching for optimal assignment
Verify graph coloring prevents conflicting task assignments
Validate community detection groups related tasks
Confirm knapsack solver optimizes resource allocation
Verify TSP solver minimizes agent traversal cost
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Optimal task allocation with conflict-free assignments

test_scenarios.name: Formal Verification of Consensus Protocol
steps: Model consensus protocol in formal verification framework
Verify safety property: no two nodes commit different values
Verify liveness property: consensus eventually reached
Validate Byzantine fault tolerance bounds
Confirm model checking passes for all reachable states
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Consensus protocol formally verified for safety and liveness

test_components.name: Infrastructure Provisioning and Multi-Cloud
test_components.description: Validate IaC provisioning, multi-cloud deployment, and compliance

test_scenarios.name: GitOps Deployment Pipeline
steps: Commit infrastructure changes to Git
Verify ArgoCD detects drift and syncs cluster state
Validate canary deployment (5% → 25% → 50% → 100%)
Confirm automatic rollback on error rate > 0.1%
Verify K8s NetworkPolicies enforce default-deny
Validate HPA scaling based on custom metrics
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: GitOps pipeline deploys safely with canary and auto-rollback

test_scenarios.name: Multi-Cloud Failover
steps: Deploy workloads across AWS, Azure, and GCP
Inject region failure in primary cloud
Verify cross-cloud failover within 15 minutes (RTO)
Validate data consistency with RPO < 1 minute
Confirm cost optimization across cloud providers
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Multi-cloud failover within RTO/RPO targets

test_scenarios.name: Compliance as Code
steps: Run Checkov, tfsec, OPA, and Sentinel policy scans
Verify all IaC passes compliance policies
Validate SOC 2 Type II controls
Confirm container security scanning (Trivy)
Verify runtime threat detection (Falco)
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: All infrastructure passes compliance scanning

test_components.name: Observability — Metrics, Traces, Logs to Alerting
test_components.description: Validate full observability stack with SLO-based alerting

test_scenarios.name: End-to-End Trace Correlation
steps: Execute full trading lifecycle
Verify OpenTelemetry trace context propagates through all 10-15 services
Confirm trace_id injected into structured JSON logs
Validate Jaeger captures complete trace with <2ms span granularity
Verify Prometheus metrics align with trace timing
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Full trace correlation across all services, MTTD <2 minutes

test_scenarios.name: SLO Burn Rate Alerting
steps: Define SLOs for latency, availability, and correctness
Inject gradual degradation (latency increase)
Verify SLO burn rate alert triggers before SLO violation
Confirm PagerDuty notification for P1 alerts
Validate alert fatigue reduction via SLO-based routing
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: SLO burn rate alerts fire before violations, P1 pages on-call

test_components.name: Chaos Engineering — Controlled Failure Injection
test_components.description: Validate system resilience through controlled failure injection

test_scenarios.name: Random Service Failure
steps: Randomly kill 10% of microservices during trading hours
Verify circuit breakers open for failed services
Confirm fallback mechanisms engage (greedy heuristic, inverse-variance)
Validate no cascading failures
Verify automatic recovery when services restart
Confirm kill switch triggers if risk limits breached during chaos
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: System survives 10% random failure without cascading or risk breach

test_scenarios.name: Network Partition Between Regions
steps: Inject network partition between US-East and EU-Central
Verify partition-tolerant consensus continues
Confirm no split-brain in Tier 1 orchestrators
Validate settlement safety during partition
Verify state reconciliation after partition heals
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: No split-brain, settlement safe, consistent after heal

test_scenarios.name: Kafka Cluster Degradation
steps: Kill 1 of 3 Kafka brokers
Verify producer failover to remaining brokers
Confirm consumer rebalancing completes
Validate DLQ captures failed messages
Verify zero data loss with transactional producers
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Kafka cluster tolerates broker failure, zero data loss

test_components.name: Regulatory Compliance — MiFID II, RTS 6, Basel III
test_components.description: Validate regulatory compliance across trading, risk, and reporting

test_scenarios.name: Pre-Trade Risk Controls (MiFID II)
steps: Execute orders approaching position limits
Verify pre-trade risk checks block orders exceeding limits
Validate transaction reporting includes all required fields
Confirm algorithmic trading flags set correctly
Verify best execution analysis across venues
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: All MiFID II pre-trade controls enforced

test_scenarios.name: Kill Switch Testing (RTS 6)
steps: Trigger kill switch via risk breach
Verify all algorithms halt within regulatory timeframe
Confirm kill switch test documentation generated
Validate real-time monitoring captures kill switch event
Verify post-incident review workflow initiated
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: RTS 6 kill switch requirements fully satisfied

test_scenarios.name: Basel III FRTB Capital Calculation
steps: Run 99% 10-day VaR calculation via FHS
Validate expected shortfall for FRTB SA
Verify stress testing with pre-computed scenarios
Confirm capital calculation matches regulatory formula
Validate audit trail supports regulatory examination
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Basel III FRTB calculations accurate and auditable

parallelization.strategy: Shard by test component (E2E-001 through E2E-010)
parallelization.isolation: Each shard runs in isolated namespace

data_management.state_reset: Database snapshot restore between test runs
data_management.kafka_cleanup: Topic truncation and consumer group reset between runs

functional: All 10 E2E test components pass with 100% scenario success rate
Kill chain testing verifies safe failure at every injection point
Cross-domain data consistency maintained throughout all flows
reliability: System survives 10% random service failure without cascading
Zero data loss during Kafka broker failure
Automatic recovery from all injected failures within 5 minutes
compliance: All regulatory scenarios pass (MiFID II, RTS 6, Basel III)
Audit trail completeness verified for all trading flows
Zero-trust security enforced on all service-to-service calls

risk_areas.mitigation: Deploy test runners in each region, measure consensus latency with clock synchronization
Use transactional producers in test environment, verify deduplication via idempotent consumers
Use Hyperledger Fabric in solo consensus mode for testing, verify PvP atomicity
Use fixed ONNX model weights, deterministic inference mode, fixed random seeds
Run chaos tests only in isolated staging environment, kill switch always armed
